description: Everything a wallet has on Borro: stock lent, shorts (owed, money held, the price it is closed for you at, and parts: how much of the stock's one short is the wallet's own, a pair's and a basket leg's), USDG loans, USDG lent, open pairs (each with short_now, its own part of the short), gap covers bought and its part of the gap cover pool, options held, written and on order (with what to do next and one yearly number for premiums over what they locked), bear coins it launched, $BORRO to claim, its locker rebates (the share of Borro's fees it gets back for its $BORRO lock, what is owed and what has been paid), and its ETH and USDG.
